title: 一份好规程是怎么写成的
source_doc: course/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/43_BIORISK MANAGEMENT STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURES.md
author_source: project/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/43_BIORISK MANAGEMENT STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURES/src.py

points.K4: 以读者为中心，让使用者参与
points.K10: 一个计划，拆成多份规程
points.K14: 行动：步骤清楚，可做检查单
points.K23: 小结：一份规程一个结果

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张空白检查单，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank checklist and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天讲标准操作规程。
overlay: 一份好规程是怎么写成的

shots.scene: 欣欣在检查单上画了一个大对勾
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot draws a big check mark on the checklist.
shots.narration: 看看一份好规程怎么写出来。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研各自处理废物，一个装袋，一个直接倒进桶里
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student handle lab waste differently: one bags it, the other drops it straight into a bin.
shots.narration: 同一件事，阿杰和小研做法不一样。

shots.scene: 两人看着对方，面面相觑
shots.prompt_en: The two look at each other, puzzled.
shots.narration: 到底谁对？

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白规程走来
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks over holding a blank procedure document.
shots.narration: 王老师说：缺一份写清楚的规程。

shots.scene: 管理控制文件夹里抽出一页规程
shots.prompt_en: A procedure page is pulled out of a management folder. No people.
shots.narration: 标准操作规程是一种管理控制。

shots.scene: 王老师在白板前，白板空白
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands at a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 今天从零学怎么写。

shots.scene: 四个不同颜色的人形，都指向同一个流程图标
shots.prompt_en: Four figure icons of different colors all point to the same process icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不同的人照同一份规程做，

shots.scene: 四条线汇到同一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: Four lines converge on the same check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 结果应该基本一样。

shots.scene: 样本管和病人图标、报告单图标
shots.prompt_en: A sample tube icon, a patient icon and a blank report icon. No people.
shots.narration: 做检测，这是对送检人负责。

shots.scene: 四条线分别指向四个不同的图表
shots.prompt_en: Four lines point to four different charts. No people.
shots.narration: 要是各做各的，结果都不同，

shots.scene: 规程页上出现修改笔
shots.prompt_en: A pen starts editing the procedure page. No people.
shots.narration: 那就说明规程要修改。

shots.section_title: 以读者为中心，让使用者参与
shots.scene: 规程页中心是一个读者图标
shots.prompt_en: A procedure page with a reader icon at its center. No people.
shots.narration: 规程是写给使用者看的，
overlay: 以读者为中心，让使用者参与

shots.section_title: 以读者为中心，让使用者参与
shots.scene: 王老师和小研、阿杰围坐讨论空白草稿
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator sits with the female graduate student and the young male student discussing a blank draft.
shots.narration: 写的时候就请他们一起参与，

shots.section_title: 以读者为中心，让使用者参与
shots.scene: 阿杰指着草稿提建议，王老师记下
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at the draft with a suggestion and the safety administrator notes it.
shots.narration: 定稿前先听一线的意见。

shots.scene: 四个图标：书本、思考泡泡、动手、工具
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a book, a thought bubble, a hand at work and a tool. No people.
shots.narration: 好规程让人懂道理、想得出流程，

shots.scene: 阿杰照着规程操作仪器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student follows the procedure to operate an instrument.
shots.narration: 能动手做，会用工具。

shots.scene: 规程每步旁有尺子图标
shots.prompt_en: A ruler icon beside each step of the procedure. No people.
shots.narration: 每一步都做得到，查得清。

shots.scene: 五个圆圈组成循环：分析、设计、编写、实施、评估
shots.prompt_en: Five circles forming a cycle with icons for analyze, design, write, implement and evaluate. No people.
shots.narration: 写规程分五步：

shots.scene: 循环箭头转动起来
shots.prompt_en: The cycle arrows start rotating. No people.
shots.narration: 分析、设计、编写、实施、评估，

shots.scene: 评估之后箭头回到分析
shots.prompt_en: After evaluation, the arrow loops back to analysis. No people.
shots.narration: 评估完再回头改，循环往复。

shots.scene: 三层台阶：最上是指南针，中间是清单，最下是脚印
shots.prompt_en: Three steps: a compass at the top, a list in the middle and footprints at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 政策定方向，

shots.scene: 中间一层亮起
shots.prompt_en: The middle step lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 计划排好要做的一串事，

shots.scene: 最下一层亮起
shots.prompt_en: The bottom step lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 程序写清每件事怎么做。

shots.scene: 三个问号卡片：笔、眼睛、靶心
shots.prompt_en: Three question cards with a pen, an eye and a target. No people.
shots.narration: 动笔前先问三件事。

shots.scene: 王老师和老周、小研一起商量
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator consults with the older man and the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 谁写：管理人员和一线人员、负责人商量。

shots.scene: 实验人员和穿工作服的外部承包商图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a laboratory worker and an outside contractor in overalls. No people.
shots.narration: 给谁看：实验人员和外部承包商。

shots.scene: 靶心中间是废物桶图标
shots.prompt_en: A target with a waste bin icon in the center. No people.
shots.narration: 为什么：按规定安全处置废物。

shots.scene: 流程：垃圾桶到漏斗分类
shots.prompt_en: A flow: a waste bin leading into a sorting funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 先想清楚全过程：废物产生、分类，

shots.scene: 漏斗分出三类：生物危害、放射性、化学
shots.prompt_en: The funnel splits into three streams marked with a biohazard symbol, a radiation symbol and a chemical bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 生物、放射性、化学分开，

shots.scene: 容器贴上空白标签，装上卡车
shots.prompt_en: Containers get blank labels and are loaded onto a truck. No people.
shots.narration: 贴好标识，再运走处置。

shots.scene: 实验室里的高压灭菌器，箭头再指向外部焚烧处理站
shots.prompt_en: An autoclave inside the lab, with an arrow pointing to an outside incineration facility. No people.
shots.narration: 生物废物先在本地灭菌，再外送焚烧。

shots.section_title: 一个计划，拆成多份规程
shots.scene: 一本计划分出七张小卡片
shots.prompt_en: One plan splits into seven small cards. No people.
shots.narration: 一个计划，拆成多份规程：
overlay: 一个计划，拆成多份规程

shots.section_title: 一个计划，拆成多份规程
shots.scene: 七张卡片依次亮起，最后两张是讲台和防护服图标
shots.prompt_en: The seven cards light up in turn; the last two show a lectern and a protective suit. No people.
shots.narration: 收集、分类、运输、去污、标识，

shots.section_title: 一个计划，拆成多份规程
shots.scene: 讲台和防护服两张卡片放大
shots.prompt_en: The lectern and protective suit cards enlarge. No people.
shots.narration: 还有培训和个人防护。

shots.scene: 规程页分成四格：对勾、地球、清单、文件
shots.prompt_en: A procedure page divided into four boxes: a check, a globe, a list and a document. No people.
shots.narration: 一份规程有四个部分：

shots.scene: 四格依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The four boxes light up in turn. No people.
shots.narration: 条件、背景、行动、文件。

shots.scene: 四个问号：人、时钟、问号、地图钉
shots.prompt_en: Four question icons: a person, a clock, a question mark and a map pin. No people.
shots.narration: 条件回答：谁用、何时用，

shots.scene: 地图钉落在实验室、运输车和处置站
shots.prompt_en: Map pins drop on the lab, the transport truck and the disposal site. No people.
shots.narration: 为什么用、在哪儿用。

shots.scene: 规程从一个实验室搬到另一个实验室，中间一个验证印章
shots.prompt_en: A procedure moves from one lab to another, passing a validation stamp in between. No people.
shots.narration: 挪到别处用，要重新试用验证。

shots.scene: 公式图：废物袋加手势等于对勾
shots.prompt_en: An equation diagram: a waste bag plus a working hand equals a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 输入加行动，得到输出。

shots.scene: 清单：受训人员、存放区、分类桶、运输车、灭菌器图标都打勾
shots.prompt_en: A checklist with ticks next to trained staff, storage area, sorting bins, a truck and an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 先假定条件已具备：人员受训，

shots.scene: 存放、分类、运输、去污四个设施图标
shots.prompt_en: Four facility icons: storage, sorting, transport and decontamination. No people.
shots.narration: 存放、分类、运输、去污设施都有。

shots.scene: 其中一个图标缺失，旁边补上一张新规程卡
shots.prompt_en: One icon is missing and a new procedure card is added in its place. No people.
shots.narration: 缺哪样，就先补一份规程。

shots.section_title: 行动：步骤清楚，可做检查单
shots.scene: 表格三列：序号、步骤、勾选栏，内容空白
shots.prompt_en: A blank table with three columns: step number, action and a checkbox. No people.
shots.narration: 行动写清从输入到输出的每一步，
overlay: 行动：步骤清楚，可做检查单

shots.section_title: 行动：步骤清楚，可做检查单
shots.scene: 小研把废物装进指定容器并贴空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts waste into a designated container and sticks on a blank label.
shots.narration: 装入指定容器，贴好标签，

shots.section_title: 行动：步骤清楚，可做检查单
shots.scene: 暂存区一半被容器占满，小研拿起电话
shots.prompt_en: A staging area half filled with containers; the female graduate student picks up a phone.
shots.narration: 暂存区满一半，就通知运输方，

shots.section_title: 行动：步骤清楚，可做检查单
shots.scene: 容器装车固定，送往指定地点
shots.prompt_en: Containers are loaded and strapped onto a truck heading to a designated site. No people.
shots.narration: 装车固定，送到指定地点。

shots.section_title: 行动：步骤清楚，可做检查单
shots.scene: 检查单每一步打勾
shots.prompt_en: Each step on the checklist gets a tick. No people.
shots.narration: 一步一勾，不含糊。

shots.scene: 规程后面附着一叠附录页，有法槌图标和书本图标
shots.prompt_en: A stack of appendix pages behind the procedure with a gavel icon and a book icon. No people.
shots.narration: 附录列出参考指南，

shots.scene: 附录里法规图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: The regulation icon in the appendix lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 和国家、地方的相关法规。

shots.scene: 阿杰在工作台旁试用新规程，王老师在旁观察
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tries out the new procedure at the bench while the safety administrator observes.
shots.narration: 新规程先到工作台试用，问四个问题：

shots.scene: 阿杰对着一段术语挠头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head at a confusing line.
shots.narration: 看得懂吗？太专业就改简单。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿一件过小的防护服，动作受限
shots.prompt_en: The young male student struggles in a protective suit that is too small.
shots.narration: 做得到吗？衣服不合身也做不好。

shots.scene: 两张结果图并排，一样的打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two result charts side by side with matching check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 结果对吗？不同人结果一样吗？

shots.scene: 王老师在空白记录本上记下问题
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator writes the issues in a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 试用中发现的问题都记下来。

shots.scene: 一张空白问卷，每行只有“是”“否”两个框
shots.prompt_en: A blank questionnaire where each line has only yes and no boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 验证用观察题，只答是或否。

shots.scene: 小研按顺序穿防护服，王老师在问卷上勾“是”
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on her suit in the right order and the safety administrator ticks yes.
shots.narration: 比如：是否按规程穿防护服？

shots.scene: 勾到“否”，旁边出现放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A no box is ticked and a magnifying glass appears beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 答否，就去查原因。

shots.scene: 四个图标：对勾、靶心、上升箭头、扩音器
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a check mark, a target, an upward arrow and a megaphone. No people.
shots.narration: 观察题客观，观察的人也在进步，

shots.scene: 多人结果中一个异常点被圈出，大家围过来讨论
shots.prompt_en: One odd point among many results is circled and the team gathers to discuss it.
shots.narration: 一人做不到，可能是系统问题，要沟通。

shots.scene: 王老师请阿杰一起编问卷
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator invites the young male student to help write the questionnaire.
shots.narration: 编问卷，请被观察的人一起参与，

shots.scene: 小研对照问卷自查
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks herself against the questionnaire.
shots.narration: 自我检查，比外人检查更真实。

shots.scene: 几个人围桌讨论规程草稿，多轮箭头
shots.prompt_en: People around a table discussing a draft procedure, with arrows showing several rounds.
shots.narration: 规程要经过商议，

shots.scene: 老周在规程上盖空白批准章
shots.prompt_en: The older man stamps a blank approval seal on the procedure.
shots.narration: 批准后在单位内正式生效，

shots.scene: 批准记录放入档案盒
shots.prompt_en: The approval record goes into an archive box. No people.
shots.narration: 批准过程也要留记录。

shots.scene: 规程页上一颗跳动的心形图标
shots.prompt_en: A procedure page with a beating heart icon. No people.
shots.narration: 规程是“活”的，要定期审查。

shots.scene: 险兆、事故、结果不一致三个图标连到修改笔
shots.prompt_en: Icons for near miss, accident and inconsistent results all connect to an editing pen. No people.
shots.narration: 出了险情、事故，结果不一致，就要改。

shots.scene: 修订记录页上一长串修改，被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A revision history page with a long list of changes, circled. No people.
shots.narration: 改得太频繁，说明某步有毛病。

shots.scene: 王老师翻阅日志，和小研、阿杰一起讨论
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews logbooks and discusses with the female graduate student and the young male student.
shots.narration: 改之前先看记录，和使用者一起改，

shots.scene: 缺设备、沟通不畅两个障碍图标被搬开
shots.prompt_en: Obstacle icons for missing equipment and poor communication are moved aside. No people.
shots.narration: 缺设备、沟通不畅，都要想办法解决。

shots.scene: 规程封面：空白单位标识、受控文件章、修订号
shots.prompt_en: A procedure cover with a blank logo area, a controlled document stamp and a revision number box. No people.
shots.narration: 封面写明受控文件和修订号，

shots.scene: 超过三页的规程前面加目录页
shots.prompt_en: A table of contents page is added to the front of a longer procedure. No people.
shots.narration: 篇幅长的加目录，

shots.scene: 术语表和目的页
shots.prompt_en: A glossary page and a purpose page. No people.
shots.narration: 生僻术语要解释，目的要写清，

shots.scene: 编号的步骤列表
shots.prompt_en: A numbered list of steps. No people.
shots.narration: 操作步骤按顺序一条条写。

shots.scene: 规程里一个红色感叹号警示框
shots.prompt_en: A red exclamation warning box inside the procedure. No people.
shots.narration: 有健康风险的步骤要写警示，

shots.scene: 两份规程重叠，消毒液瓶和生锈的设备图标
shots.prompt_en: Two overlapping procedures with a disinfectant bottle and a rusted equipment icon. No people.
shots.narration: 同时用几份规程，写明相互影响，

shots.scene: 比如溢洒消毒剂伤人、腐蚀设施的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons showing a disinfectant harming skin and corroding a fixture. No people.
shots.narration: 比如消毒剂伤皮肤、腐蚀设备。

shots.scene: 质量图标、参考书、联系人、附录图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons for quality control, references, contacts and appendices. No people.
shots.narration: 还有质量控制、参考、联系人、附录。

shots.scene: 王老师登记规程份数和存放位置
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator records the number of copies and where they are kept.
shots.narration: 发几份、放哪里，由管理员定，

shots.scene: 所有版本整齐放进档案盒
shots.prompt_en: All versions are filed neatly into an archive box. No people.
shots.narration: 各个版本都归档，备查。

shots.section_title: 小结：一份规程一个结果
shots.scene: 欣欣举着检查单
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up the checklist.
shots.narration: 小结：规程让谁做结果都一样。
overlay: 小结：一份规程一个结果

shots.section_title: 小结：一份规程一个结果
shots.scene: 口罩卡片和全套防护卡片分开放
shots.prompt_en: A mask card and a full protective gear card placed separately. No people.
shots.narration: 一份规程只管一个结果，

shots.section_title: 小结：一份规程一个结果
shots.scene: 两张卡片各配一张空白规程
shots.prompt_en: Two cards, each paired with its own blank procedure sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 戴口罩一份，穿全套防护另一份。

shots.section_title: 小结：一份规程一个结果
shots.scene: 使用者、管理者、负责人围成圈
shots.prompt_en: A circle of the worker, the safety administrator and the older man.
shots.narration: 写时听各方意见，

shots.section_title: 小结：一份规程一个结果
shots.scene: 循环箭头和上升台阶
shots.prompt_en: A cycle arrow and steps going upward. No people.
shots.narration: 不断试用、验证、改进。

shots.section_title: 小结：一份规程一个结果
shots.scene: 验证、评估两个图标连成一个循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: Verification and evaluation icons joined in a loop arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 验证和评估，是持续改进的关键。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、阿杰按同一份规程操作，结果都打勾，一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the female graduate student and the young male student follow the same procedure, get matching check marks and wave goodbye.
shots.narration: 照规程做，人人都安全，再见！
